name: What should I prepare before contacting AKN Design Group about a porch or covered patio project?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before contacting AKN Design Group about a porch or covered patio project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before contacting AKN Design Group for your porch or covered patio project, considering a few key details can streamline our initial consultation. Think about how you envision using the space—for entertaining, relaxation, dining, or a combination. Having an idea of your preferred aesthetic, any specific features you desire (like an outdoor kitchen or fireplace), and a general understanding of your budget can be very helpful. While not essential, any inspiration photos or sketches can also aid in communicating your vision. This preparation helps us understand your needs better, allowing us to provide tailored insights and begin designing your customized renovation effectively.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before contacting us, consider how you'll use the space, your preferred aesthetic, desired features, and a general budget. Any inspiration photos are also helpful for our initial consultation.
